topic: Coffee4U rendered checkout delivery-method coverage: destination locality lists and fees for the tracked Crema e Gusto 250 g listing
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through scripts/browser-research.mjs (npm run research:browser), one live session kept across steps. One temporary anonymous cart was built from the real product page (1 x Lavazza Crema e gusto 250 gr טחון, ₪38); the public checkout reached through https://www.coffee4u.co.il/cart.asp was read. Destination localities were selected only from the vendor's own autocomplete list (Tel Aviv - Yafo, Eilat) plus one courier-only control locality (Abu Ghosh). No street address, name, phone, email, order, payment, login or account was entered or submitted, and no bot challenge or access control was bypassed. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The available file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the two screenshots were not machine-inspected by the model. Every value below is backed by rendered visible text / DOM excerpts captured through the same live session; the screenshots are kept as artifacts for a human reviewer. No claim of image-based visual review is made for this batch.

coverage.cartItem: Lavazza Crema e gusto 250 gr טחון — 1 x 250 g, ₪38.00, variant not stated

methods.label: שליחות מדלת לדלת עד 1-5 ימי עסקים (door-to-door courier, 1-5 business days)
methods.excerpt: שליחות מדלת לדלת עד 1-5 ימי עסקים - 30 ₪ | משלוח ₪30 | סכום כולל מע"מ ₪68
methods.qualification: The destination is chosen from the checkout's own closed locality list; a value that is not an exact list entry is rejected (input cleared, select cleared, red border, message 'City not found. Please select a city from the list above.'). Selecting Tel Aviv - Yafo or Eilat did not change the ₪30 fee or remove the method; no locality restriction message appeared.

methods.label: משלוח לנקודת איסוף צ`יטה שופס (Chiita Shops pickup point, up to 7 business days, up to 5 kg / 30x30x30)

destinationField.element: chita_cities (closed <select>) plus a per-locality spot list (chita_spots)

methods.excerpt: משלוח לנקודת איסוף צ`יטה שופס (עד 7 ימי עסקים - עד 5 ק"ג 30*30*30) - 15 ₪ | משלוח ₪15 | סכום כולל מע"מ ₪53
methods.qualification: The pickup-point city must come from the 420-locality list and a specific spot must then be chosen. Selecting Eilat or Tel Aviv - Yafo populated real spots (listed above). For Abu Ghosh (a courier locality with no pickup entry) the method still showed ₪15 / ₪53 in the summary, but the required pickup-point selector contained only its placeholder — the public estimator does not print an explicit coverage error at that step.

controlLocality.name: Abu Ghosh (אבו גוש)
controlLocality.observed: u_city = 'אבו גוש'; chita_cities = '' (no entry); chita_spots = placeholder only; the method picker still offered the ₪15 pickup point and the summary still printed ₪15 / ₪53.

relationshipToEarlierEvidence: Reproduces and extends the 18:17-18:19 UTC observations in 2026-10-12-vendor-shipping-quotes.json (same ₪30 courier / ₪15 pickup-point rates, same 1,270-entry destination list and 421-city pickup list). New in this batch: the destination lists are closed and exact-match, Tel Aviv - Yafo and Eilat were actually selected without changing the fees, the pickup lists carry real per-locality spots, and a courier-only control locality shows the pickup selector has no entries outside the 420-locality list.
